title: Toyota’s Hybrid Gamble Paid Off As EV Hype Fades
summary: Toyota is increasing its hybrid vehicle production by 30% by 2028, aiming for 60% of its total vehicle production to be hybrids. This strategy positions Toyota favorably in a market where electric vehicle sales have cooled and the average vehicle price has risen, potentially pricing out one-third of Americans from buying a new car.
sentiment_reason: The strategy reflects a positive market impact as it aligns with current market conditions where hybrid vehicles are more affordable and in demand compared to the higher-priced electric vehicles.
